feat(config): add c12 and support rulesync configs

Fixes #30.

Funny story -- I made a _very similar_ tool the other day and figured I'd just upstream some of this 🎉. This all works, but I'd suggest we figure out what you think the best options are for the config file. I'd lean towards supporting `rulesync.jsonc` to align with more modern tooling, but leaving the door open for other formats that provide value such as `.ts` or `.js` with jsdoc (and we can allow `.rulesyncrc` as well). Originally implemented this with `cosmicconfig`, but `c12` is nice and opens the door for more advanced github/gitlab/etc based template syncing mechanisms in the future via `extends`.
